title: Will and going to; shall
summary: Will и going to для будущего: спонтанные решения и планы, предсказания по мнению и по признакам, обещания, угрозы, отказ (won't), типичное поведение, was going to, а также shall в предложениях, предложениях помощи и формальных текстах.
ru:
## Решение: заранее или в момент речи
Главное различие касается **момента принятия решения**. **Going to** говорит о том, что намерение или план **уже существуют** до разговора. **Will** выражает решение, **принятое в момент речи**, либо мнение, обещание, предложение.
> A: Why have you bought all this wood? B: I'm going to build a shed. — Зачем тебе столько досок? — Я построю сарай. (решение принято раньше)
> A: We've run out of coffee. B: I'll pick some up on my way home. — У нас кончился кофе. — Куплю по дороге. (решение возникло сейчас)

## Предсказания: мнение или признаки
**Going to** используем, когда есть **признаки, указывающие на будущее**, и мы уверены, потому что видим ситуацию. **Will** — когда это **наше мнение, ожидание, предположение**, особенно с **I think, I expect, probably, I'm sure, perhaps**.
> Look at that sky — it's going to pour. — Посмотри на небо: сейчас польёт. (по признакам)
> I think the new law will cause problems. — Думаю, новый закон вызовет проблемы. (мнение)
В ситуациях, где признаков нет, а речь о далёком будущем или общих выводах, лучше **will**: **By 2050, most cars will be electric.**

## Другие функции will
- **Обещание, предложение, готовность:** **I'll call you tonight.** / **I'll help you with that.**
- **Угроза или предупреждение:** **Do that again and I'll report you.**
- **Просьба:** **Will you hold this for a second?** (**would** вежливее)
- **Отказ (won't):** **She won't listen to anyone.** Также о вещах: **The car won't start.** — Машина не заводится.
- **Типичное поведение / общие свойства:** **Oil will float on water.** — Масло держится на воде. **He'll sit for hours doing crosswords.** — Он может часами разгадывать кроссворды.

## Was going to
**Was/were going to** говорит о плане, который **был в прошлом и не осуществился** (либо пока неясно):
> I was going to ring you, but my battery died. — Я собирался тебе позвонить, но сел телефон.

## Shall
**Shall** сегодня употребляется в основном в трёх случаях.
- **Предложение и вопрос о желании** (с I и we): **Shall I open the window?** — Открыть окно? **Shall we start?** — Начнём? **What shall we do?** — Что нам делать?
- **Хвост вопроса после Let's:** **Let's take a break, shall we?**
- **Официальные тексты:** **The tenant shall pay the rent monthly.** — Арендатор обязуется платить ежемесячно.
В британском английском **I shall / we shall** встречается и как торжественное будущее (**We shall overcome**), в американском это звучит старомодно.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Look out! You will fall!~~ (по признакам) → You're **going to** fall!
- ~~Will I open the window?~~ → **Shall** I open the window?
- ~~I'm going to get it~~ (в ответ на звонок, спонтанно) → **I'll** get it.
- ~~If you will go, I will go.~~ (в условии) → If you **go**, I'll go.
en:
## Decision: in advance or at the moment of speaking
The main difference is **when the decision was made**. **Going to** shows that the intention or plan **already exists** before the conversation. **Will** expresses a decision **made at the moment of speaking**, or an opinion, a promise, an offer.
> A: Why have you bought all this wood? B: I'm going to build a shed. (decided earlier)
> A: We've run out of coffee. B: I'll pick some up on my way home. (decided now)

## Predictions: opinion or evidence
We use **going to** when there is **evidence in the present** that points to the future and we feel sure because we see the situation. We use **will** for **our opinion, expectation or guess**, especially with **I think, I expect, probably, I'm sure, perhaps**.
> Look at that sky - it's going to pour. (evidence)
> I think the new law will cause problems. (opinion)
For distant or general predictions without evidence, **will** is better: **By 2050, most cars will be electric.**

## Other uses of will
- **Promises, offers, willingness:** **I'll call you tonight.** / **I'll help you with that.**
- **Threats and warnings:** **Do that again and I'll report you.**
- **Requests:** **Will you hold this for a second?** (**would** is more polite)
- **Refusal (won't):** **She won't listen to anyone.** Also for things: **The car won't start.**
- **Typical behaviour / general properties:** **Oil will float on water.** **He'll sit for hours doing crosswords.**

## Was going to
**Was/were going to** talks about a plan **made in the past that did not happen** (or whose result is unclear):
> I was going to ring you, but my battery died.

## Shall
**Shall** is used today mainly in three ways.
- **Offers and asking what someone wants** (with I and we): **Shall I open the window?** **Shall we start?** **What shall we do?**
- **Question tag after Let's:** **Let's take a break, shall we?**
- **Formal and legal texts:** **The tenant shall pay the rent monthly.**
In British English **I shall / we shall** also appears as a solemn future (**We shall overcome**); in American English it sounds old-fashioned.

## Common mistakes
- ~~Look out! You will fall!~~ (evidence) → You're **going to** fall!
- ~~Will I open the window?~~ → **Shall** I open the window?
- ~~I'm going to get it~~ (spontaneous reply to a ringing phone) → **I'll** get it.
- ~~If you will go, I will go.~~ (in a condition) → If you **go**, I'll go.
structure:
## Формы
| | Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|---|
| will | I will / I'll go. | I won't go. | Will you go? |
| going to | She is going to go. | She isn't going to go. | Is she going to go? |
| was going to | We were going to go. | We weren't going to go. | Were you going to go? |
| shall | Shall I / we go? | Shan't (редко) | Shall we go? |

## Формулы
> **will** + V (спонтанное решение, мнение, обещание)
> I'll get the door.

> **am/is/are going to** + V (план, признаки)
> We're going to move in May.

> **Shall I / we** + V? (предложение, вопрос о желании)
> Shall I carry that?

## Сравнительная таблица
| Значение | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Заранее принятый план | going to | I'm going to study law. |
| Решение сейчас | will | OK, I'll take it. |
| Предсказание по признакам | going to | It's going to snow. |
| Мнение, ожидание | will | I think she'll win. |
| Обещание | will | I'll be there. |
| Угроза | will | I'll tell her! |
| Отказ | won't | It won't work. |
| Типичное поведение | will | He'll talk for hours. |
| Несбывшийся план | was going to | I was going to go. |
| Предложение | shall I / we | Shall I help? |
| Правило, закон | shall | Members shall vote. |

exercises.title: Will, going to или shall?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте пропущенные слова (will, going to, shall) в нужной форме.
exercises.example: Look at those clouds — it ___ rain. → it's going to rain.

items.text: Look at those clouds - it {{is going to|'s going to}} rain.
I've decided: I {{am going to|'m going to}} quit my job and travel for a year.
- The phone's ringing. - {{I'll|I will}} get it.
{{Shall I|Should I}} open the window? It's stuffy in here.
I'm sure you {{will|'ll}} enjoy the concert.
I {{won't|will not}} tell anyone your secret, I promise.
We {{are going to|'re going to}} have a baby in April.
He {{won't|will not}} listen to me, however hard I try.

exercises.title: Планы, признаки, формальный стиль
exercises.instruction: Вставьте пропущенные слова (will, going to, shall, was going to).

items.text: I {{was going to}} call you yesterday, but I forgot.
A: We've run out of milk. B: Oh, {{I'll|I will}} buy some on my way home.
She {{is going to|'s going to}} study medicine - she's already applied.
Careful! You {{are going to|'re going to}} spill that coffee.
The tenant {{shall}} pay the rent on the first day of each month.
She {{will|'ll}} probably be late; she always is.
{{Will you|Would you|Could you|Can you}} pass me the salt, please?

exercises.title: Выберите правильную форму
exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, который лучше всего подходит по смыслу.

items.q: I've bought paint - I ___ redecorate the hall this weekend.
Don't worry about the bags. I ___ carry them.
___ I help you with the forms?
A: Why have you bought so much flour? B: I ___ bake bread.
This door ___ open! I've tried everything.
Tenants ___ not sublet the property without written consent.

options: Wait - I'm going to carry that for you.
Wait - I'll carry that for you.
Look at the sky: it will rain.
Look at the sky: it's going to rain.
Shall you come to the party tonight?
Will you come to the party tonight?
items.why: Shall в вопросах только с I и we.

options: We were going to visit you, but the car broke down.
We would going to visit you, but the car broke down.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение из слов, используя will, going to или shall.

items.prompt: (I / get / it) — спонтанное решение: звонит телефон
answers: I'll get it.
I will get it.

items.prompt: (I / learn / Italian / next year) — заранее принятый план
answers: I'm going to learn Italian next year.
I am going to learn Italian next year.
Shall I carry your bags?
The engine won't start.
The engine will not start.

items.prompt: (the boss / be / furious / when / he / see / this)
answers: The boss will be furious when he sees this.
The boss is going to be furious when he sees this.
The boss's going to be furious when he sees this.
Shall we meet outside the station?
I promise I won't be late.
I promise I will not be late.
I promise that I won't be late.
I promise that I will not be late.

exercises.title: Перепишите предложение
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя слово или форму в скобках.

items.prompt: I intended to call you, but I forgot. (was going to)
answers: I was going to call you, but I forgot.
I was going to call you but I forgot.

items.prompt: Tenants must not keep pets. (shall, формальный стиль)
answers: Tenants shall not keep pets.

items.prompt: Can you lend me a pen? (will, вежливая просьба)
answers: Will you lend me a pen?

items.prompt: Do that again, or I call the police. (will, угроза)
answers: Do that again and I will call the police.
Do that again and I'll call the police.
Do that again, or I will call the police.
Do that again, or I'll call the police.

items.prompt: My laptop refuses to turn on. (won't)
answers: My laptop won't turn on.
Shall we order pizza?

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте на вопросы полными предложениями на английском, используя will, going to, shall.

items.prompt: What are you going to do this weekend? (план)
items.sample: I'm going to visit my parents and then go hiking on Sunday.

items.prompt: Make a prediction about your city in ten years (use will and I think).
items.sample: I think my city will be much more crowded, and there will be more electric buses.

items.prompt: Offer to help a colleague who is carrying too many things.
items.sample: Shall I take some of those boxes for you?

items.prompt: Write about something you were going to do but didn't.
items.sample: I was going to start a diet in January, but I never did.

items.prompt: Make a promise to a friend or a family member.
items.sample: I promise I'll help you move house next month.
